messages.text:
"Create a 3D game gritty, dark third-person stealth-survival game inspired by Manhunt 1 where the protagonist wakes up disoriented after being kidnapped and forced into a brutal, televised underground hunting ordeal inside decaying, claustrophobic night-time urban alleys, shuttered storefronts, damp brick corridors, and dimly lit backstreets lit only by flickering lights and burning trash barrels, wrapped in a paranoid analog VHS camcorder aesthetic with subtle scanlines, grain, and REC HUD overlays. Feature heavy, urgent, slightly hunched third-person running animations with natural arm swing and weapon-in-hand grip variations, smooth crouch-to-sprint transitions, a shadow-stealth system where stepping into deep darkness turns the player invisible to patrolling hunters unless they make noise or collide, and interactive pick-up mechanics allowing the player to scavenge, carry, throw, or perform brutal close-quarters stealth takedowns with makeshift street weapons like knives, wooden bats, bricks, and pipes.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
